plan.title: Choose a Live Event with an Existing Vendor Bid

steps.note: Confirm the Events list rendered with its controls and no error.
Restrict the selection to currently live events, since bid revisions require bidding to remain open.
Open the first event shown in the Live tab as the candidate existing event.
Confirm the selected event displays the Live state.
Open the buyer's comparison grid to verify that vendor bidding data is present for the selected event.
Assert that the bid grid contains real vendor columns rather than placeholders.
